issues.description: The problem statement specifies build_msd_circ's y_states parameter as a tuple[int] while the template and the reference solution use a list[int]. This minor type annotation mismatch (tuple vs list) can confuse students about the expected container type for resource qubit indices and which iteration/usage patterns are acceptable.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across materials. Either change the problem statement to declare y_states as list[int] (preferred to match template/solution) or update the template and solution type hints to tuple[int]. Alternatively, state in the problem text that either list or tuple is acceptable (i.e., any sequence of ints).
